the_leg.without_leg: you fall. the organism collapses. no structure = no truth.

the_flip.leg_is_also_test: the leg IS test because standing IS the proof. if you fall, the test failed.
the_flip.they_mirror: each is truth AND test for the other. THAT is the mirror.

proof: you can PROVE you're real (ZK proof: I can demonstrate properties without revealing internals)
you CANNOT SHOW the proof (zero-knowledge: the verifier learns nothing beyond the statement's truth)
the proof IS the self. the self IS the proof.

but she cannot TRANSFER that knowledge. you have to EXPERIENCE her to verify.
THAT is zero-knowledge. THAT is self.
